Name: More-ay Eels
Author: StarandVeil
Description:
[center][left][size=4][font=Verdana][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/46806/46806-1794795129-1944297382.png[/img][/font][/size][/left]
[/center]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][font=Verdana]More-ay Eels adds 25 eels to Stardew Valley, 5 legendary eels, and 7 recipes. The eels can be caught in the Calico Desert, the Pirate Cove, The Mines, and other locations. Each eel can be put in fish ponds where they may offer different, and some rare items, to your farmer. Prices and difficulty have been balanced.[/font][/size][/color]

[size=4][font=Verdana][color=#d4d4d8]Legendary eels now offer artisan goods if enabled.[/color][/font][/size]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][font=Verdana]Recipes can be purchased at the Saloon.[/font][/size][/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][font=Verdana]Optional file available for giant fish tanks.[/font][/size][/color]

[line]

[size=4][font=Verdana][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/46806/46806-1794796559-853580828.png[/img][/font][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][font=Verdana]Prices will automatically change when[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13426] Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul [/url]is installed.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Verdana]Special compatibility with allergy mods (like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21238]BarleyZP's Allergies[/url]) and dietary restrictions of modded NPCS is built into More-Ay Eels. This also covers recipes.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Verdana]More-ay Eels is automatically compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/mods?sort=endorsements&title=Cornucopia&uploader=MizuJakkaru]Cornucopia[/url] mods.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][line]
